verse_text_english: In the name of GOD, Most Gracious, Most Merciful.
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: S.*, and the Quran that contains the message.
verse_text_arabic: صٓ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
verse_text_transliterated: sad wal-qur'āni dhī l-dhik'r
verse_footnote_english: 38:1. frequency of occurrence of this letter in the three suras is 152 (19 x 8). Appendix 1 for details of the Quran’s miraculous numerical code.  22. we are just feuding against one another. equitably and without bias? Guide us to the right way.
verse_text_arabic_clean: ص والقرءان ذى الذكر

verse_text_english: Those who disbelieve are plunged in pride and defiance. 3.
verse_text_arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
verse_text_transliterated: bali alladhīna kafarū fī ʿizzatin washiqāqi
verse_text_arabic_clean: بل الذين كفروا فى عزة وشقاق

verse_text_english: Many a generation before them we annihilated. They called for help; in vain.
verse_text_arabic: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
verse_text_transliterated: kam ahlaknā min qablihim min qarnin fanādaw walāta ḥīna manāṣi
verse_text_arabic_clean: كم أهلكنا من قبلهم من قرن فنادوا ولات حين مناص

verse_text_english: They wondered that a warner should come to them, from among them. The disbelievers said, "A magician; a liar.
verse_text_arabic: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
verse_text_transliterated: waʿajibū an jāahum mundhirun min'hum waqāla l-kāfirūna hādhā sāḥirun kadhābu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وعجبوا أن جاءهم منذر منهم وقال الكفرون هذا سحر كذاب

verse_text_english: “Does he want to make the gods one god?
verse_text_arabic: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْءَالِهَةَ إِلَٰهًا وَٰحِدًا إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
verse_text_transliterated: ajaʿala l-ālihata ilāhan wāḥidan inna hādhā lashayon ʿujābu
verse_text_arabic_clean: أجعل الءالهة إلها وحدا إن هذا لشىء عجاب

verse_text_english: The leaders announced, "Go and steadfastly persevere in worshiping your gods. This is what is desired.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inṭalaqa l-mala-u min'hum ani im'shū wa-iṣ'birū ʿalā ālihatikum inna hādhā lashayon yurād
verse_text_arabic_clean: وانطلق الملأ منهم أن امشوا واصبروا على ءالهتكم إن هذا لشىء يراد

verse_text_english: “We never heard of this before. This is a fabrication.
verse_text_arabic: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَٰقٌ
verse_text_transliterated: mā samiʿ'nā bihādhā fī l-milati l-ākhirati in hādhā illā ikh'tilāqu
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما سمعنا بهذا فى الملة الءاخرة إن هذا إلا اختلق

verse_text_english: “Did he, out of all us, receive the message?" Thus, they are doubtful about My message. They have not tasted My retribution yet. 9.
verse_text_arabic: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
verse_text_transliterated: a-unzila ʿalayhi l-dhik'ru min bayninā bal hum fī shakkin min dhik'rī bal lammā yadhūqū ʿadhāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: أءنزل عليه الذكر من بيننا بل هم فى شك من ذكرى بل لما يذوقوا عذاب

verse_text_english: Do they own the treasures of mercy of your Lord, the Almighty, the Grantor?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
verse_text_transliterated: am ʿindahum khazāinu raḥmati rabbika l-ʿazīzi l-wahāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم عندهم خزائن رحمة ربك العزيز الوهاب

verse_text_english: Do they possess the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them? Let them help themselves.
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَٰبِ
verse_text_transliterated: am lahum mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā falyartaqū fī l-asbāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم لهم ملك السموت والأرض وما بينهما فليرتقوا فى الأسبب

verse_text_english: Their forces will always be defeated, no matter how numerous. 12.
verse_text_arabic: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
verse_text_transliterated: jundun mā hunālika mahzūmun mina l-aḥzāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: جند ما هنالك مهزوم من الأحزاب

verse_text_english: Disbelieving before them were the people of Noah, 'Ãd, and the mighty Pharaoh.
verse_text_arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
verse_text_transliterated: kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin waʿādun wafir'ʿawnu dhū l-awtād
verse_text_arabic_clean: كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح وعاد وفرعون ذو الأوتاد

verse_text_english: Also, Thamûd, the people of Lot, the dwellers of the Woods (of Midyan); those were the opponents.
verse_text_arabic: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
verse_text_transliterated: wathamūdu waqawmu lūṭin wa-aṣḥābu al'aykati ulāika l-aḥzāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: وثمود وقوم لوط وأصحب لـٔيكة أولئك الأحزاب

verse_text_english: All of them disbelieved the messenger, and thus incurred retribution.
verse_text_arabic: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
verse_text_transliterated: in kullun illā kadhaba l-rusula faḥaqqa ʿiqāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن كل إلا كذب الرسل فحق عقاب

verse_text_english: As for these, all they need is one blow, from which they never recover. 16.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā yanẓuru hāulāi illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan mā lahā min fawāqi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما ينظر هؤلاء إلا صيحة وحدة ما لها من فواق

verse_text_english: They challenged: "Our Lord, why do you not rush the retribution for us, before the Day of Reckoning."
verse_text_arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verse_text_transliterated: waqālū rabbanā ʿajjil lanā qiṭṭanā qabla yawmi l-ḥisāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقالوا ربنا عجل لنا قطنا قبل يوم الحساب

verse_text_english: Be patient in the face of their utterances, and remember our servant David, the resourceful; he was obedient.
verse_text_arabic: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verse_text_transliterated: iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wa-udh'kur ʿabdanā dāwūda dhā l-aydi innahu awwābu
verse_text_arabic_clean: اصبر على ما يقولون واذكر عبدنا داود ذا الأيد إنه أواب

verse_text_english: We subdued the mountains in his service, day and night.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse_text_transliterated: innā sakharnā l-jibāla maʿahu yusabbiḥ'na bil-ʿashiyi wal-ish'rāq
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا سخرنا الجبال معه يسبحن بالعشى والإشراق

verse_text_english: Also, the birds were mobilized to serve him. 20.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-ṭayra maḥshūratan kullun lahu awwābu
verse_text_arabic_clean: والطير محشورة كل له أواب

verse_text_english: We strengthened his kingship, and endowed him with wisdom and good logic.
verse_text_arabic: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
verse_text_transliterated: washadadnā mul'kahu waātaynāhu l-ḥik'mata wafaṣla l-khiṭāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: وشددنا ملكه وءاتينه الحكمة وفصل الخطاب

verse_text_english: Have you noted the opponents who climbed into his sanctuary?
verse_text_arabic: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ
verse_text_transliterated: wahal atāka naba-u l-khaṣmi idh tasawwarū l-miḥ'rāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: وهل أتىك نبؤا الخصم إذ تسوروا المحراب

verse_text_english: When they entered his room, he was startled. They said, "Have no fear. We are feuding with one another, and we are seeking your fair judgment. Do not wrong us, and guide us in the right path.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
verse_text_transliterated: idh dakhalū ʿalā dāwūda fafaziʿa min'hum qālū lā takhaf khaṣmāni baghā baʿḍunā ʿalā baʿḍin fa-uḥ'kum baynanā bil-ḥaqi walā tush'ṭiṭ wa-ih'dinā ilā sawāi l-ṣirāṭ
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ دخلوا على داود ففزع منهم قالوا لا تخف خصمان بغى بعضنا على بعض فاحكم بيننا بالحق ولا تشطط واهدنا إلى سواء الصرط

verse_text_english: “This man is my brother, and he owns ninety-nine sheep, while I own one sheep.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ
verse_text_transliterated: inna hādhā akhī lahu tis'ʿun watis'ʿūna naʿjatan waliya naʿjatun wāḥidatun faqāla akfil'nīhā waʿazzanī fī l-khiṭāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن هذا أخى له تسع وتسعون نعجة ولى نعجة وحدة فقال أكفلنيها وعزنى فى الخطاب

verse_text_english: He said, "He is being unfair to you by asking to combine your sheep with his. Most people who combine their properties treat each other unfairly, except those who believe and work righteousness, and these are so few." Afterwards, David wondered if he made the right judgment. He thought that we were testing him. He then implored his Lord for forgiveness, bowed down, and repented.*
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla laqad ẓalamaka bisuāli naʿjatika ilā niʿājihi wa-inna kathīran mina l-khulaṭāi layabghī baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti waqalīlun mā hum waẓanna dāwūdu annamā fatannāhu fa-is'taghfara rabbahu wakharra rākiʿan wa-anāb
verse_footnote_english: *38:24 In this clear example, 99 on one side vs 1 on the other side, David's extreme care to render the correct judgment caused him to ask forgiveness. Are we this careful?
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال لقد ظلمك بسؤال نعجتك إلى نعاجه وإن كثيرا من الخلطاء ليبغى بعضهم على بعض إلا الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت وقليل ما هم وظن داود أنما فتنه فاستغفر ربه وخر راكعا وأناب

verse_text_english: We forgave him and reserved for him a reward and a beautiful abode. 26.
verse_text_arabic: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
verse_text_transliterated: faghafarnā lahu dhālika wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazul'fā waḥus'na maābi
verse_text_arabic_clean: فغفرنا له ذلك وإن له عندنا لزلفى وحسن مـٔاب

verse_text_english: O David, we have made you a ruler on earth. Therefore, you shall judge among the people equitably, and do not follow your personal opinion, lest it diverts you from the way of GOD. Surely, those who stray off the way of GOD incur severe retribution for forgetting the Day of Reckoning.
verse_text_arabic: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verse_text_transliterated: yādāwūdu innā jaʿalnāka khalīfatan fī l-arḍi fa-uḥ'kum bayna l-nāsi bil-ḥaqi walā tattabiʿi l-hawā fayuḍillaka ʿan sabīli l-lahi inna alladhīna yaḍillūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun bimā nasū yawma l-ḥisāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: يداود إنا جعلنك خليفة فى الأرض فاحكم بين الناس بالحق ولا تتبع الهوى فيضلك عن سبيل الله إن الذين يضلون عن سبيل الله لهم عذاب شديد بما نسوا يوم الحساب

verse_text_english: We did not create the heaven and the earth, and everything between them, in vain. Such is the thinking of those who disbelieve. Therefore, woe to those who disbelieve; they will suffer in Hell.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَٰطِلًا ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā khalaqnā l-samāa wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā bāṭilan dhālika ẓannu alladhīna kafarū fawaylun lilladhīna kafarū mina l-nār
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما خلقنا السماء والأرض وما بينهما بطلا ذلك ظن الذين كفروا فويل للذين كفروا من النار

verse_text_english: Shall we treat those who believe and lead a righteous life as we treat those who commit evil on earth? Shall we treat the righteous as we treat the wicked?
verse_text_arabic: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ
verse_text_transliterated: am najʿalu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti kal-muf'sidīna fī l-arḍi am najʿalu l-mutaqīna kal-fujār
verse_text_arabic_clean: أم نجعل الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت كالمفسدين فى الأرض أم نجعل المتقين كالفجار

verse_text_english: This is a scripture that we sent down to you, that is sacred—perhaps they reflect on its verses. Those who possess intelligence will take heed.
verse_text_arabic: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verse_text_transliterated: kitābun anzalnāhu ilayka mubārakun liyaddabbarū āyātihi waliyatadhakkara ulū l-albāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: كتب أنزلنه إليك مبرك ليدبروا ءايته وليتذكر أولوا الألبب

verse_text_english: We granted to David Solomon, a good servant; he totally submitted.
verse_text_arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wawahabnā lidāwūda sulaymāna niʿ'ma l-ʿabdu innahu awwābu
verse_text_arabic_clean: ووهبنا لداود سليمن نعم العبد إنه أواب

verse_text_english: One evening he became preoccupied with his beautiful horses. 32.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ
verse_text_transliterated: idh ʿuriḍa ʿalayhi bil-ʿashiyi l-ṣāfinātu l-jiyād
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ عرض عليه بالعشى الصفنت الجياد

verse_text_english: He then said, "I enjoyed the material things more than I enjoyed worshiping my Lord, until the sun was gone.*
verse_text_arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verse_text_transliterated: faqāla innī aḥbabtu ḥubba l-khayri ʿan dhik'ri rabbī ḥattā tawārat bil-ḥijāb
verse_footnote_english: *38:32 Solomon missed his afternoon prayer because of his horses. To nullify Satan's possible claim that Solomon loved his horses more than loving God, he got rid of his horses.
verse_text_arabic_clean: فقال إنى أحببت حب الخير عن ذكر ربى حتى توارت بالحجاب

verse_text_english: "Bring them back." (To bid farewell,) he rubbed their legs and necks.
verse_text_arabic: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ
verse_text_transliterated: ruddūhā ʿalayya faṭafiqa masḥan bil-sūqi wal-aʿnāq
verse_text_arabic_clean: ردوها على فطفق مسحا بالسوق والأعناق

verse_text_english: We thus put Solomon to the test; we blessed him with vast material wealth, but he steadfastly submitted.*
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
verse_text_transliterated: walaqad fatannā sulaymāna wa-alqaynā ʿalā kur'siyyihi jasadan thumma anāb
verse_footnote_english: *38:34 & 41 Solomon and Job represent both ends of the testing spectrum. We are put to the test through wealth, health, or lack of them, to see if we worship God alone under all circumstances.
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولقد فتنا سليمن وألقينا على كرسيه جسدا ثم أناب

verse_text_english: He said, "My Lord, forgive me, and grant me a kingship never attained by anyone else. You are the Grantor."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla rabbi igh'fir lī wahab lī mul'kan lā yanbaghī li-aḥadin min baʿdī innaka anta l-wahāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال رب اغفر لى وهب لى ملكا لا ينبغى لأحد من بعدى إنك أنت الوهاب

verse_text_english: We (answered his prayer and) committed the wind at his disposal, pouring rain wherever he wanted.
verse_text_arabic: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
verse_text_transliterated: fasakharnā lahu l-rīḥa tajrī bi-amrihi rukhāan ḥaythu aṣāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: فسخرنا له الريح تجرى بأمره رخاء حيث أصاب

verse_text_english: Also, the devils were subjugated as builders and divers.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-shayāṭīna kulla bannāin waghawwāṣi
verse_text_arabic_clean: والشيطين كل بناء وغواص

verse_text_english: Many others were bound in his service.
verse_text_arabic: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
verse_text_transliterated: waākharīna muqarranīna fī l-aṣfād
verse_text_arabic_clean: وءاخرين مقرنين فى الأصفاد

verse_text_english: These are our provisions; you can donate or withhold without limits.
verse_text_arabic: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse_text_transliterated: hādhā ʿaṭāunā fa-um'nun aw amsik bighayri ḥisābi
verse_text_arabic_clean: هذا عطاؤنا فامنن أو أمسك بغير حساب

verse_text_english: We have reserved for him a reward and a beautiful abode. 312
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazul'fā waḥus'na maābi
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن له عندنا لزلفى وحسن مـٔاب

verse_text_english: Remember our servant Job: he called upon his Lord, "The devil has afflicted me with hardship and pain."
verse_text_arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-udh'kur ʿabdanā ayyūba idh nādā rabbahu annī massaniya l-shayṭānu binuṣ'bin waʿadhābi
verse_text_arabic_clean: واذكر عبدنا أيوب إذ نادى ربه أنى مسنى الشيطن بنصب وعذاب

verse_text_english: (We said,) "Strike the ground with your foot.
verse_text_arabic: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ
verse_text_transliterated: ur'kuḍ birij'lika hādhā mugh'tasalun bāridun washarābu
verse_text_arabic_clean: اركض برجلك هذا مغتسل بارد وشراب

verse_text_english: We restored his family for him; twice as many. Such is our mercy; a reminder for those who possess intelligence.
verse_text_arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
verse_text_transliterated: wawahabnā lahu ahlahu wamith'lahum maʿahum raḥmatan minnā wadhik'rā li-ulī l-albāb
verse_subtitle_english: God Makes it up to the Believers
verse_text_arabic_clean: ووهبنا له أهله ومثلهم معهم رحمة منا وذكرى لأولى الألبب

verse_text_english: "Now, you shall travel the land and preach the message, to fulfill your pledge." We found him steadfast. What a good servant! He was a submitter.
verse_text_arabic: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَٰهُ صَابِرًا نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wakhudh biyadika ḍigh'than fa-iḍ'rib bihi walā taḥnath innā wajadnāhu ṣābiran niʿ'ma l-ʿabdu innahu awwābu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وخذ بيدك ضغثا فاضرب به ولا تحنث إنا وجدنه صابرا نعم العبد إنه أواب

verse_text_english: Remember also our servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. They were resourceful, and possessed vision.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-udh'kur ʿibādanā ib'rāhīma wa-is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba ulī l-aydī wal-abṣār
verse_text_arabic_clean: واذكر عبدنا إبرهيم وإسحق ويعقوب أولى الأيدى والأبصر

verse_text_english: We blessed them with a special blessing, being mindful of the final abode.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ
verse_text_transliterated: innā akhlaṣnāhum bikhāliṣatin dhik'rā l-dār
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنا أخلصنهم بخالصة ذكرى الدار

verse_text_english: They were among our chosen righteous people.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-innahum ʿindanā lamina l-muṣ'ṭafayna l-akhyār
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإنهم عندنا لمن المصطفين الأخيار

verse_text_english: Recall also Ishmael, Elisha, and Dhalkifl; all were pious.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-udh'kur is'māʿīla wal-yasaʿa wadhā l-kif'li wakullun mina l-akhyār
verse_text_arabic_clean: واذكر إسمعيل واليسع وذا الكفل وكل من الأخيار

verse_text_english: This is a message; the righteous have deserved a beautiful destiny.
verse_text_arabic: هَٰذَا ذِكْرٌ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
verse_text_transliterated: hādhā dhik'run wa-inna lil'muttaqīna laḥus'na maābi
verse_text_arabic_clean: هذا ذكر وإن للمتقين لحسن مـٔاب

verse_text_english: The gardens of Eden will be wide open for them.
verse_text_arabic: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ
verse_text_transliterated: jannāti ʿadnin mufattaḥatan lahumu l-abwāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: جنت عدن مفتحة لهم الأبوب

verse_text_english: Relaxing therein, they will enjoy many fruits and drinks.
verse_text_arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ
verse_text_transliterated: muttakiīna fīhā yadʿūna fīhā bifākihatin kathīratin washarābi
verse_text_arabic_clean: متكـٔين فيها يدعون فيها بفكهة كثيرة وشراب

verse_text_english: With them will be the most magnificent spouses.
verse_text_arabic: وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ
verse_text_transliterated: waʿindahum qāṣirātu l-ṭarfi atrābu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وعندهم قصرت الطرف أتراب

verse_text_english: This is promised for you on the day of reckoning.
verse_text_arabic: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verse_text_transliterated: hādhā mā tūʿadūna liyawmi l-ḥisāb
verse_text_arabic_clean: هذا ما توعدون ليوم الحساب

verse_text_english: Our provision to you will never end.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
verse_text_transliterated: inna hādhā lariz'qunā mā lahu min nafādi
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن هذا لرزقنا ما له من نفاد

verse_text_english: As for the transgressors, they have deserved a terrible destiny.
verse_text_arabic: هَٰذَا وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍ
verse_text_transliterated: hādhā wa-inna lilṭṭāghīna lasharra maābi
verse_subtitle_english: The Disbelievers: Feuding With One Another
verse_text_arabic_clean: هذا وإن للطغين لشر مـٔاب

verse_text_english: Hell, wherein they burn; what a miserable abode!
verse_text_arabic: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
verse_text_transliterated: jahannama yaṣlawnahā fabi'sa l-mihād
verse_text_arabic_clean: جهنم يصلونها فبئس المهاد

verse_text_english: They will suffer therein, with boiling lava and bitter food.
verse_text_arabic: هَٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ
verse_text_transliterated: hādhā falyadhūqūhu ḥamīmun waghassāqu
verse_text_arabic_clean: هذا فليذوقوه حميم وغساق

verse_text_english: Also, other kinds, equally bad. 59.
verse_text_arabic: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ
verse_text_transliterated: waākharu min shaklihi azwāju
verse_text_arabic_clean: وءاخر من شكله أزوج

verse_text_english: "This is a group to be thrown into Hell with you." They will not be welcomed (by the residents of Hell). They have deserved to burn in the hellfire.
verse_text_arabic: هَٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ
verse_text_transliterated: hādhā fawjun muq'taḥimun maʿakum lā marḥaban bihim innahum ṣālū l-nār
verse_text_arabic_clean: هذا فوج مقتحم معكم لا مرحبا بهم إنهم صالوا النار

verse_text_english: The newcomers will respond, "Nor are you welcomed. You are the ones who preceded us and misled us. Therefore, suffer this miserable end."
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū bal antum lā marḥaban bikum antum qaddamtumūhu lanā fabi'sa l-qarār
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا بل أنتم لا مرحبا بكم أنتم قدمتموه لنا فبئس القرار

verse_text_english: They will also say, "Our Lord, these are the ones who led us into this; double the retribution of hellfire for them."
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِى ٱلنَّارِ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū rabbanā man qaddama lanā hādhā fazid'hu ʿadhāban ḍiʿ'fan fī l-nār
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا ربنا من قدم لنا هذا فزده عذابا ضعفا فى النار

verse_text_english: They will say, "How come we do not see (in Hell) people we used to count among the wicked?
verse_text_arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ
verse_text_transliterated: waqālū mā lanā lā narā rijālan kunnā naʿudduhum mina l-ashrār
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقالوا ما لنا لا نرى رجالا كنا نعدهم من الأشرار

verse_text_english: “We used to ridicule them, and we diverted our eyes from them.”
verse_text_arabic: أَتَّخَذْنَٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ
verse_text_transliterated: attakhadhnāhum sikh'riyyan am zāghat ʿanhumu l-abṣār
verse_text_arabic_clean: أتخذنهم سخريا أم زاغت عنهم الأبصر

verse_text_english: It is an established truth that the people of hell will feud with each other.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ
verse_text_transliterated: inna dhālika laḥaqqun takhāṣumu ahli l-nār
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن ذلك لحق تخاصم أهل النار

verse_text_english: Say, "I warn you; there is no other god beside GOD, the One, the Supreme.
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
verse_text_transliterated: qul innamā anā mundhirun wamā min ilāhin illā l-lahu l-wāḥidu l-qahār
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل إنما أنا منذر وما من إله إلا الله الوحد القهار

verse_text_english: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; the Almighty, the Forgiving."
verse_text_arabic: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ
verse_text_transliterated: rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā l-ʿazīzu l-ghafār
verse_text_arabic_clean: رب السموت والأرض وما بينهما العزيز الغفر

verse_text_english: Say, "Here is awesome news.
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: qul huwa naba-on ʿaẓīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل هو نبؤا عظيم

verse_text_english: "That you are totally oblivious to.
verse_text_arabic: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: antum ʿanhu muʿ'riḍūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أنتم عنه معرضون

verse_text_english: "I had no knowledge previously, about the feud in the High Society.*
verse_text_arabic: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: mā kāna liya min ʿil'min bil-mala-i l-aʿlā idh yakhtaṣimūn
verse_footnote_english: *38:69 The feud in the High Society was triggered by Satan's challenge to God's absolute authority. This is definitely the most important event in the history of the human race. We failed to make a firm stand regarding God's absolute authority. This life represents the third and final chance to redeem ourselves (See the Introduction and Appendix 7).
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما كان لى من علم بالملإ الأعلى إذ يختصمون

verse_text_english: "I am inspired that my sole mission is to deliver the warnings to you."
verse_text_arabic: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: in yūḥā ilayya illā annamā anā nadhīrun mubīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن يوحى إلى إلا أنما أنا نذير مبين

verse_text_english: Your Lord said to the angels, "I am creating a human being from clay.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن طِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: idh qāla rabbuka lil'malāikati innī khāliqun basharan min ṭīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ قال ربك للملئكة إنى خلق بشرا من طين

verse_text_english: "Once I design him, and blow into him from My spirit, you shall fall prostrate before him."
verse_text_arabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-idhā sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu fīhi min rūḥī faqaʿū lahu sājidīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإذا سويته ونفخت فيه من روحى فقعوا له سجدين

verse_text_english: The angels fell prostrate, all of them,
verse_text_arabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fasajada l-malāikatu kulluhum ajmaʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فسجد الملئكة كلهم أجمعون

verse_text_english: except Satan; he refused, and was too arrogant, unappreciative.
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: illā ib'līsa is'takbara wakāna mina l-kāfirīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا إبليس استكبر وكان من الكفرين

verse_text_english: He said, "O Satan, what prevented you from prostrating before what I created with My hands? Are you too arrogant? Have you rebelled?"
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla yāib'līsu mā manaʿaka an tasjuda limā khalaqtu biyadayya astakbarta am kunta mina l-ʿālīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال يإبليس ما منعك أن تسجد لما خلقت بيدى أستكبرت أم كنت من العالين

verse_text_english: He said, "I am better than he; You created me from fire, and created him from clay."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla anā khayrun min'hu khalaqtanī min nārin wakhalaqtahu min ṭīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال أنا خير منه خلقتنى من نار وخلقته من طين

verse_text_english: He said, "Therefore, you must be exiled, you will be banished.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla fa-ukh'ruj min'hā fa-innaka rajīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال فاخرج منها فإنك رجيم

verse_text_english: "You have incurred My condemnation until the Day of Judgment."
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inna ʿalayka laʿnatī ilā yawmi l-dīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن عليك لعنتى إلى يوم الدين

verse_text_english: He said, "My Lord, respite me till the Day of Resurrection."
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla rabbi fa-anẓir'nī ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال رب فأنظرنى إلى يوم يبعثون

verse_text_english: He said, "You are respited.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla fa-innaka mina l-munẓarīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال فإنك من المنظرين

verse_text_english: "Until the appointed day."
verse_text_arabic: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
verse_text_transliterated: ilā yawmi l-waqti l-maʿlūm
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلى يوم الوقت المعلوم

verse_text_english: He said, "I swear by Your majesty, that I will send them all astray.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla fabiʿizzatika la-ugh'wiyannahum ajmaʿīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال فبعزتك لأغوينهم أجمعين

verse_text_english: "Except Your worshipers who are devoted absolutely to You alone."
verse_text_arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: illā ʿibādaka min'humu l-mukh'laṣīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إلا عبادك منهم المخلصين

verse_text_english: He said, "This is the truth, and the truth is all that I utter.
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla fal-ḥaqu wal-ḥaqa aqūl
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال فالحق والحق أقول

verse_text_english: I will fill Hell with you and all those who follow you.
verse_text_arabic: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: la-amla-anna jahannama minka wamimman tabiʿaka min'hum ajmaʿīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: لأملأن جهنم منك وممن تبعك منهم أجمعين

verse_text_english: Say, "I do not ask you for any wage, and I am not an imposter.
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qul mā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin wamā anā mina l-mutakalifīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قل ما أسـٔلكم عليه من أجر وما أنا من المتكلفين

verse_text_english: "This is a reminder for the world.
verse_text_arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: in huwa illā dhik'run lil'ʿālamīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن هو إلا ذكر للعلمين

verse_text_english: "And you will certainly find out in awhile."
verse_text_arabic: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ
verse_text_transliterated: walataʿlamunna naba-ahu baʿda ḥīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولتعلمن نبأه بعد حين
